visual_review.method: the 41 problem pages are the published Korean problem paper (2021.html) with stamps re-pointed to the identical-geometry pages of the solutions PDF (image/drawing boxes verified identical), spot-checked side by side; every one of the 47 solution pages compared side by side with the source at 50-60 dpi, with 100-288 dpi close-ups of English words inside equation lines (covered by Korean overlay labels on p69 and p85); first-line baselines of every prose block measured against the source's outlined-glyph ink baselines (first lines within about 1 pt after calibration, a few continuation lines under tall inline fractions within 2.8 pt; mean offset +0.17 pt over 508 lines); edgecheck clean except the intentionally split logo halves on p4/p12/p21; check.py leaves only cover-photo backgrounds, overlay labels sitting on their stamps, logo/equation stamp overlap on p57 (same source pixels), the full-page stamp of the blank last page and box-only overlaps without visible collision; no TeX leftovers or replacement characters in the PDF text
